author: reek
body: The minus binds to whatever it abuts. All four spacings appear here, and each line answers a different number, so no line can pass by accident.

author: reek
body: arg-lit and arg-only are the shapes that used to be subtraction and would not compile at all. three-args is the one that pins how TIGHTLY a negation binds: the negated argument is a single atom, so `three 1 -2 3` is three arguments and not `three 1 (-(2 3))`. left-abut and hyphen-digit pin the other two spacings, and arrow pins the one exception, since a hyphen before a greater-than is the arrow and not a name character.
